headline: Assembly Technician
summary: Assembly technician with three years building and repairing electronic modules in General Santos. I assemble and solder boards and small parts under magnification, troubleshoot faulty units from wiring diagrams, and maintain the hand tools and fixtures we use. Detail-oriented and patient with fine work.
skills: Mechanical maintenance of fixtures and tools

experience.title: Assembly Technician
bullets: Assemble fish-finder and radio modules for fishing boats, about 60 units a day.
Solder fine-pitch components and cables under a microscope.
Repair and rework units returned by fishing fleets, tracing faults from wiring diagrams.
Maintain soldering stations, jigs and fixtures and record repairs in Excel.

experience.title: Electronics Repair Assistant
bullets: Repaired radios, TVs and chargers for walk-in customers.
Replaced parts and tested repaired units.
